description: The paper promises to introduce a basic ordinary differential equation (ODE) model for cholera transmission dynamics, which includes Susceptible (S), Infectious (I), and Recovered (R) human populations and a bacterial concentration in a water reservoir (B). It also promises to discuss modifications to this basic model to incorporate concepts such as asymptomatic infections, waning immunity, human-to-human transmission, and the impact of interventions like vaccination, treatment, and various water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) strategies.
